ev.q: Among persons observed indoors, 91.7% wore masks correctly.
mask use was more prevalent at on-campus (94.8%) than at nearby off-campus locations (90.6%)
mask use was more prevalent at on-campus (94.8%) than at nearby off-campus locations (90.6%)
N95-type masks most likely to be worn correctly indoors (96.8%)
Trained student observers recorded mask use for up to 8 weeks from fixed sites on campus and nearby.

methods_quotes.q: Chi-squared tests were used to compare indoor mask use and indoor correct mask use for on-campus and nearby off-campus locations.
The Tukey honestly significant difference test was used to compare mask types among the proportion used correctly indoors
Frequencies and ranges were calculated for mask use, correct mask use, type of mask worn, and locations observed.
Correct mask use was recorded if the mask completely covered the nose and mouth and was secured under the chin.
